prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "Your pet is now active in your taskbar. Use quick hotkeys or right-click the system tray icon anytime to interact or hide them.", "Right-click tray icon to manage", "Welcome to your desktop companion setup!"]
1: ["Choose Visual Render Aesthetics", "Preview how your companion will be drawn on your desktop before uploading reference images.", "Continue to Photo Upload"]
2: ["How Would You Like to Adopt Your Selected Friend?", "Pick a preset companion template or create a unique custom creation."]
3: ["Creating Your Desktop Companion...", "We are crafting your pet's desktop sprites and animations.", "Play Companion Greeting", "Rendering desktop companion elements..."]
4: ["Tip: Double-click pet to talk, click & drag to move across monitors, right-click to hide.", "Double Click: Speak", "Right Click: Tray Menu"]
5: ["Choose Your Adoption Experience", "Instant Adoption vs Custom Photo Generation"]
6: ["Lock Your Pet Profile to Your Account", "Signing in ensures your desktop companion, settings, and memory are securely saved to the cloud so you never lose your pet.", "Sign In & Save Pet"]
7: ["Your pet will automatically pop up on your primary monitor when generation finishes."]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate Ready", "Your official pet companion registration is finalized. Proceed to spawn your pet on your desktop.", "Verified Unique Desktop Companion #1"]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Watch how your pet lives, plays, and stays on your screen while you work.", "Choose My Pet Path"]
